rules.name: Direct vulnerability
rules.description: Resolved direct package versions with a current OSV affected-by relationship.

rules.name: Transitive vulnerability
rules.description: Vulnerable versions reached through the resolved transitive dependency graph.

rules.name: Deprecated dependency
rules.description: Resolved versions explicitly marked deprecated by registry metadata.

rules.name: Unused direct dependency
rules.description: Direct dependencies without an observed static reference or runtime event.

rules.name: Version fragmentation
rules.description: Multiple resolved versions of the same package across the estate.

rules.name: Capability diversity
rules.description: Multiple curated technologies serving the same code capability.

rules.name: Dependency confusion exposure
rules.description: npm dependencies whose private registry identity or scope routing can be answered by the public npm registry.
missing_inputs: Python and other package ecosystems are not evaluated by this rule.
Registry-name collision coverage is limited to registry identities already ingested.

rules.name: License obligation exposure
rules.description: Current resolved or declared dependencies in any ingested ecosystem that sit outside the active license allow-list or carry a copyleft classification.
missing_inputs: License compatibility and distribution obligations require legal review.

rules.name: Cross-repository structural clone
rules.description: Structurally identical non-vendored code units repeated across distinct repositories.
missing_inputs: Structural identity does not by itself establish behavioral or business equivalence.

rules.name: Vendored source outside dependency management
rules.description: Scanner-classified vendored source stored in-tree and outside manifest-level dependency governance.
missing_inputs: Vendored path classification does not establish third-party origin or upstream version.

rules.name: External exposure
rules.description: Repository and infrastructure-as-code declarations for production and public entry points.

rules.name: Business-critical impact
rules.description: Findings affecting applications mapped to high-criticality capabilities in the Business Map.

rules.name: Architecture drift
rules.description: Technology patterns that diverge from governed golden stacks for capability-map peers.
